verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents one narrow bulk-like capability: a single Company Profile update automatically propagates to company records across all jurisdictions and compliance areas. Nothing shows general user-driven bulk actions across many selected items, or bulk/batch API endpoints. The OAuth and idempotency API docs are building blocks, not bulk operations. Missing for 10: general multi-item bulk actions (bulk edit/delete/file across selected entities or licenses), documented bulk or batch API endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: An update to your Company Profile allows you to automatically update company records across all jurisdictions and compliance areas, including entity, license, and tax.
